name: Alistair Davies
bio:
Alistair's journey into motorsport wasn't a direct one. He initially pursued a degree in engineering, focusing on materials science, but a summer internship with a local racing team ignited a passion that rerouted his career. He started in the workshop, learning the intricacies of race car construction and maintenance from the ground up. His meticulous attention to detail and problem-solving skills quickly earned him a reputation as a reliable and capable team member.

Over the years, Alistair progressed through various roles, gaining experience in logistics, procurement, and team management. His analytical approach, coupled with his practical understanding of the sport, makes him a highly effective Head of Operations. He excels at identifying potential bottlenecks and implementing proactive solutions to ensure the smooth running of the team's activities, both on and off the track. Alistair’s strength lies in his ability to see the bigger picture while never losing sight of the smallest details, ensuring that every aspect of the operation contributes to the team’s overall success.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Alistair has a sturdy build and a focused gaze that conveys his dedication.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with logistical diagrams and calculations.
Insists on a pre-race team breakfast of beans on toast – a tradition from his early racing days.
Has a habit of tapping his pen rhythmically when deep in thought.
